chorus_he: בָּרְכִי נַפְשִׁי אֶת־אֲדֹנָי · וְאַל־תִּשְׁכְּחִי כָּל־גְּמוּלָיו · בָּרְכִי נַפְשִׁי אֶת־אֲדֹנָי · בָּרְכִי
review: Chorus is verse 1 (four lines), C repeats all four joined by " · "; the Arabic label القرار stays as data. Psalm 103 wording retained (בָּרְכִי נַפְשִׁי, גְּמוּלָיו, מַעְטִירֵךְ, מִמְשַׁלְתּוֹ) with feminine suffix to match the Arabic's address to the soul. The "(3)" repetition marker after 1:3 is a source artifact, dropped per house style. Short 1:4 stays short. Glossary: סָלַח for غفر, פָּדָה for فدى, עָוֺן for أثام.
